prompt: Estimate to the nearest integer (unless specified otherwise) the following value: Square root of the $10312020$th prime number.

solutions.title: Official value and how to get it
solutions.body:
Official value: **13615**.

Estimate: the $n$th prime is about $n(\ln n+\ln\ln n-1)$. With $n=10312020$: $\ln n\approx16.15$, $\ln\ln n\approx2.78$, so $p_n\approx1.0312\times10^7\cdot17.93\approx1.85\times10^8$ and $\sqrt{p_n}\approx13600$. A sieve gives $p_{10312020}=185362007$, whose square root is $13614.77\approx13615$.

prompt: Let $V=100$. You flip a fair coin $20$ times. For each flip, if you flip a head, then you add $20$ to $V$, and if you flip a tail, then $V$ becomes $\frac1V$. For example, after flipping a head then a tail, $V$ is $\frac1{120}$. Calculate the expected value of $V$ at the end of $20$ flips to three decimal places.

solutions.title: Official value and how to compute it
solutions.body:
Official value: **40.524**.

The operation "$V\to1/V$" makes the expectation non-linear, so one tracks the whole distribution of $V$: start with $\{100:1\}$ and, for $20$ rounds, replace each value $v$ (probability $\pi$) by $v+20$ and $1/v$, each with probability $\pi/2$. Summing $v\cdot\pi$ at the end gives $40.524$.

prompt: Estimate to the nearest integer (unless specified otherwise) the following value: The number of digits past the decimal point after which the digits "$2020$" first appear consecutively in the decimal expansion of $\pi$.
answer: **7285** (the block $2020$ first occupies decimal places $7285$-$7288$); the official key lists $7377$

solutions.title: Search the decimal expansion
solutions.body: The official key gives **7377**. Computing the digits of $\pi$ (for example with Machin's formula $\pi=16\arctan\frac15-4\arctan\frac1{239}$) and searching shows that the block $2020$ first appears starting at decimal place $7285$ (the digits there read $\ldots742\,2020\,203\ldots$), i.e. after $7284$ digits. For an estimation question any guess in the right range is scored by closeness; the stored official number differs from the computed position.
